benefits.text: A foundation with a texture as soft as your real skin and gentle coverage of imperfections that helps create a natural effect. It feels as weightless as going bare-faced. The thin, lightweight finish does not leave skin feeling stifled, for comfortable long days. Makes skin fresh and bright with a smooth, non-cakey effect.

howToUse.text: Take an appropriate amount and blend evenly over the skin. Multiple layers can be applied for the best coverage.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: A foundation as thin and light as a second skin, creating a natural, soft, smooth base that is comfortable all day.

sellingPoints.text: Texture as soft as real skin; gentle, natural coverage; thin, lightweight finish that does not feel stifling and is not cakey.

finish.text: Natural / smooth / thin and light like real skin.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not claim perfect coverage of all imperfections. Do not say it is absolutely non-cakey in all skin conditions.
